title: Pawtato
problem: Pet owners often have no reliable way to help identify and recover a missing pet. Traditional collars and tags may only provide limited information, while people who find a lost animal have no direct way to access the owner's contact details or the pet's current missing status.
solution: Pawtato provides a digital pet identification and recovery system built around QR codes. Each pet can have a unique QR code linked to its profile, allowing anyone who finds the pet to scan the code and instantly view its live information and missing status. Owners can manage their pets, update their profiles, and flag a pet as missing so the public-facing page always reflects the latest status.

title: Huddle
problem: Group collaboration often requires switching between messaging apps, file-sharing platforms, document editors, and other tools. Students and teams working together on assignments, presentations, research, or projects can quickly end up with fragmented conversations, scattered files, and unnecessary setup.
solution: Huddle provides a temporary collaborative workspace where groups can chat, share files, and work together in real time from a single session. Users can quickly start or join a room, invite others, collaborate while they work, and export the conversation when needed without relying on a permanent workspace.

title: FairSplit
problem: Shared electricity bills are often split equally or by average usage, which becomes unfair under progressive tariff systems where higher consumption is charged at higher rates. This leaves low-usage tenants subsidizing heavier consumers and makes the final bill difficult to justify.
solution: FairSplit calculates the exact bill using tariff bands and fairly distributes costs based on each sub-meter's usage, while separately accounting for shared consumption. Every tenant receives a transparent, itemized breakdown that exactly matches the utility bill.

title: SuperOffice
problem: Managing multiple businesses under one owner often requires switching between separate dashboards, making it difficult to get a unified view of business performance, subscriptions, and operations.
solution: SuperOffice provides a centralized control panel for managing multiple businesses under a single Vastora subscription, combining cross-business oversight, analytics, business management, subscription information, and integrations while connecting owners to each business's dedicated BackOffice when deeper operational control is needed.

title: Shapla Shoibal
problem: A restaurant owner operating two branches under the same name and offering the same menu needed a convenient way to maintain and present their shared menu without having to manage the same information separately for each location.
solution: Shapla Shoibal is a trial project exploring a simple digital menu solution for the restaurant's two locations. It provides a centralized and convenient way to present the same menu online, reducing duplication and making menu information easier for the owner to manage and customers to access.
